Definition: from G1722 and G3506; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture:--make signs.
BiblicalUsage: When Zacharias could not speak, they made signs to him in Luke 1:62, asking how he would have the child called — and he wrote, His name is John.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can work through gestures and written words as well as speech, and Zacharias's silence ended in a name that means God is gracious.
